originalSourceText:
Q.5  A 1-D CNN processes a sequence of 100 acoustic frames. If its kernel of width 2
      moves by two frames at each step, what is the output sequence length? (ignore
       padding)

      (A) 50

      (B) 99

      (C)100

      (D) 1

       Explanation: If the kernel moves one frame at a time (stride=1), the output sequence
                                                                                     100
         is the same length as the input sequence. If the stride=2 then output sequence is  =
                                                                                      2
      50. (kernel centers are at 1, 3, 5, … , 99, so total are 50)
      Refer slide 18 of Lecture 48: AI based Speech Recognition
